title: Integral encoding commutes with open extension by zero
statement: For any scheme X and abelian etale sheaf A [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], let E be the canonical equivalence from abelian groups to modules over ULift Z, obtained by the inverse of the forgetful Z-module equivalence and restriction along ULift Z = Z. For any open inclusion j:U -> X [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero], E(j_!j^*A) is isomorphic to j_!j^*E(A) [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. No curve, density, torsion or constructibility hypothesis is required.

proof.text: Replace upperStar on both coefficient categories by upperStarIsoOpenImmersionRestriction. Restriction is precomposition, so it commutes with the coefficient functor sectionwise.

Unfold extension by zero as left Kan extension followed by sheafification. E preserves limits and colimits. The existing Mathlib Functor.lanCompIsoOfPreserves and sheafComposeNatIso commute E with these operations. Compose their isomorphisms and the restriction comparisons to obtain the displayed isomorphism.

theorem integral_open_extension_comparison {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (A : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (U : X.Opens) :
    let E := (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} ℤ) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).inv ⋙
      ModuleCat.restrictScalars (ULift.ringEquiv : ULift.{u + 1} ℤ ≃+* ℤ).toRingHom
    let F := (sheafCompose X.smallEtaleTopology E).obj A
    let B := (openImmersionLowerShriek AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} U.ι).obj
      ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} U.ι).obj A)
    Nonempty ((sheafCompose X.smallEtaleTopology E).obj B ≅
      (openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} ℤ)) U.ι).obj
        ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} ℤ)) U.ι).obj F))
